note: AD-123: research knobs that are not core effects. Each array is indexed by the highest rung of its branch the village has completed (0 = none). The cards read the same accessors (ResearchKnobs).
builders_note: AD-153 (owner's construction ladder, same branch as foundation): builders of the hall I..VI 2/2/4/6/8/10 (1 without research); the bag at II carries three times as much (the project's funding takes 3 stacks per visit to the hall chest, a road or wall load is 3x roads.carry); reach x2 at IV and x3 at VI (6 -> 12 -> 18 blocks: runtime work checks and the scaffold plans of new surveys); at V a kennel wolf fetches the road and wall materials from the hall chest to the builder (VillageDogs send/near).
drive_note: AD-136 (D9, CF14): the mechanics branch is gone; the shaft from the mill wheel reaches 64 blocks in every village (the old Mechanics III reach, so old worlds lose nothing).
quarry_note: When AD-112 activates the core mine.quarry_depth, that core replaces this knob; the two are never live together.
bone_meal_note: Bone meal each crop gets right after planting, taken from the farm chest (ResourceWorkGoal plant stage -> ResearchKnobs.feedCrop); false hides the card line and stops the feeding.
